objective: Turn a city or ZIP into an expert-grade, whole-year planting decision system that maximizes useful harvest windows without pretending frost dates or crop maturity are exact.

valueFunctions.definition: Recommendations respect crop biology, sowing method, maturity, frost tolerance and source-backed agronomic rules.
The calendar calculates fall windows backward from cold risk, applies slower late-season growth and schedules successions until the last viable sowing.
Uses local freeze probability as a climate anchor, keeps current forecast risk separate, and never treats USDA hardiness zone as a planting-date engine.
Shows minimum/optimal soil temperature and heat/bolting limits where relevant instead of relying on dates alone.
Separates indoor start, direct sow, hardening and transplant timing and respects transplant-sensitive crops.
Days-to-maturity is a range/default that users can override; output explains that seed-packet cultivar data wins.
Warm/subtropical climates can produce fall/winter recommendations and heat-limited summer gaps rather than a northern spring-only calendar.
Outputs follow-on crop ideas after harvest so the same bed can be used through multiple seasons.
Displays probability/source/confidence and distinguishes climatology, current forecast and heuristic fallback.
A gardener can immediately see plant now, start indoors, transplant, next succession, last viable date and harvest window.
Static crop logic works fail-soft when live forecast data is missing; no unnecessary per-crop API calls.
One canonical useful tool answers planting-now, fall garden and succession intents without thin location doorway pages.
Crop rules are structured, source-traceable and decision logic is testable outside the page.

mustProve: frost-hardy crops extend beyond first 32F risk

automaticRejects: USDA hardiness zone used as the primary planting-date calculation
single spring date with no fall or succession logic
fall planting equals spring days-to-maturity with no slowdown/safety buffer
transplant-sensitive root crops recommended as routine transplants
warm-season seed recommended into soil below crop minimum
lettuce/spinach/cilantro recommended through severe heat without warning
exact first/last frost date presented as certainty
frost-free climates told that no calendar can be built
new thin city or ZIP canonical pages created for SEO
